rows.name: Heal
rows.desc: Heals the most wounded ally for 8-12, and far more as the priest grows in level.

rows.name: Mend
rows.desc: Heals every living ally for 6-10.

rows.name: Revive
rows.desc: Raises one fallen ally with 40% health.

rows.name: Greater Heal
rows.desc: Heals the most wounded ally for 24-34.

rows.name: Divine Intervention
rows.desc: Heals every living ally for 35% of their maximum health.

rows.name: Purify
rows.desc: Cleanses every affliction on the party and heals everyone for 12-20. It heals at least that, and more as you grow: about 18 percent of the health of whoever it heals.

rows.name: Resurrection
rows.desc: Raises every fallen hero at 70% health and heals the living for half.
